stem.text: A snowflake is falling from the sky on a still day. Its weight acts vertically downwards and air resistance acts vertically upwards. As the snowflake falls, air resistance increases until it is equal to the weight and there is no resultant force acting on the snowflake.

stem.alt: Snowflake drawn between an upward arrow labelled air resistance and a downward arrow labelled weight.

stem.text: When the forces become equal, which statement is correct?

D.text: The snowflake moves at a constant velocity.
